jobs.prompt: You are job t101-compare (writing only; do not run tests). Restate done-when in one line. Write docs/_swarm/t101-compare.md, one page (<= 70 lines): compare the upstream skills to-tickets, to-spec and handoff (files to-tickets.SKILL.md, to-spec.SKILL.md, handoff.SKILL.md in context) with ours: ticket format (oasis-tickets-sample.md), contract template (templates/coordination/CONTRACT.md), handoff rules (oasis-handoff-rules.md, templates/coordination/HANDOFF.md, templates/coordination/TASK.md). Ours stays; no replacement. For each of the three: 2-line summary of what upstream does that ours does not (and the reverse), then a table of proposed line-level edits to OUR files: | our file | current line (quote, <= 15 words) or 'new line after: <quote>' | proposed line | why (<= 12 words) |. Max 6 edits per area, ranked by expected rework saved. Quote upstream at most 12 words at a time with attribution (MIT). End with 'Not adopted' (one line each). Return JSON only: {"status":"complete|blocked","filesChanged":["docs/_swarm/t101-compare.md"],"reproTest":"none","notes":"<=3 lines"}
